limits: Partial original early-thread, TLS and library initialization; explicit auxiliary vector, virtual kernel, signal state, memory primitives and two bounded allocators. Selected platform images are RWX. This is not an Android process or device oracle.
Only the pinned asset APK is installed in the native manager. Framework resources, other splits, overlays and live updates are not represented.
The actual ID-consumer run omits ad hoc post-constructor key/mutex control calls. The separate earlier manager smoke run includes them and is not claimed as normal startup.
Host orchestration supplies unchanged resource bytes to original parsers and links parsed-file output at an observed provider slot. Complete original native file ingestion is not established.

Raw ENOENT is modeled only for the explicitly declared empty virtual update/CWD paths. The original Android asset result is produced by native APK search. The stat_buffer_unchanged receipt field is a pre-snapshot; source review and a separate synthetic control establish buffer preservation.
The completed diagnostic battle still uses the older modeled asset boundary. Full421 initialization and battle integration on this new shared Android platform remain pending.
No reset, complete state, ordinary-match or byte-exact equivalence claim.
